svg.title: Where we measure the spam classifier
svg.desc: Steps 1–6 prepared the batches and classifier. Step 7 builds loss and accuracy utilities. Steps 8–10 use them during and after fine-tuning.

g.text: Steps 1–3 · Download, preprocess, and batch labeled messages.
Steps 4–6 complete · GPT-2 loaded and classifier head attached
Step 7 · Implement classification loss and accuracy
Run these measurements now to establish a baseline.
Stage 3 · Fine-tune and use the classifier
Steps 8–10 · Train, evaluate the trained classifier, and use it on new SMS.
